subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be solved as a core TUI config/template surface, a PluginStatusProvider-style SDK/rendering seam, or kept out of the persistent footer for now?
rationale: The request crosses TUI rendering, public config, provider usage/auth calls, and Plugin SDK contracts, so automation should not choose the long-term product/API boundary.

options.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
options.body: Use the PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add TUI rendering after maintainers approve ordering, truncation, caching, and security behavior.

options.title: Core TUI config template
options.body: Add first-class TUI footer template and field configuration, accepting the migration, docs, and compatibility burden of a new public config contract.

options.title: Keep existing status surfaces
options.body: Keep /status, /usage, CLI status, and Control UI usage as the supported quota/cost surfaces and reject persistent footer customization for now.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
recommendation.body: Use the PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add TUI rendering after maintainers approve ordering, truncation, caching, and security behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available routing candidate from the provider-usage/status history and the cross-surface product/API decision this issue requires.
